Definition: from G5571 and G3004; mendacious, i.e. promulgating erroneous Christian doctrine:--speaking lies.
BiblicalUsage: Pseudologos means speaking lies, mendacious, one who spreads false teaching. It appears once, of those who depart from the faith: speaking lies in hypocrisy, having their conscience seared with a hot iron.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a seared conscience is the scariest thing in the Bible: the liar no longer feels the lie, and the hypocrite no longer hears his own words.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
